subject.title: No guard against skill repos created outside canonical paths

question: Should OpenClaw add orphan `SKILL.md` detection outside configured skill roots, and should that detection run only in an explicit check or Doctor path?
rationale: The source gap is real, but scanning outside configured roots changes privacy, performance, false-positive, and startup-noise behavior, so the permanent product boundary needs maintainer intent before implementation.

options.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
options.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor, with configured-root exclusions and clear remediation.

options.title: Also Warn At Startup
options.body: Surface the same warning during gateway startup, accepting additional runtime scanning and operator-visible noise.

options.title: Document Current Scope
options.body: Keep OpenClaw limited to configured roots and improve docs instead of adding off-root scanning.

recommendation.title: Explicit Check/Doctor Diagnostic
recommendation.body: Add bounded orphan detection to `openclaw skills check` or Doctor, with configured-root exclusions and clear remediation.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest feature-history trail across skill-creator, skills CLI, and the current diagnostic boundary.
